caption:
To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Whether you show what is within yourselves or conceal it, Allah will bring you to account for it.

Surah Al-Baqarah (2:284), the first of the last three ayat of the surah. Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese and Malay renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an, Surah Al-Baqarah (2), Ayah 284 - the first of 'the last three ayat of Al-Baqarah', a set the user specifically requested and which are traditionally always cited together as this trio (2:284-286), so each is being posted separately as its own ayah per the channel's one-post-per-distinct-verse rule.
sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (edition quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Live-fetched and verified this session (2026-09-18) via GET /v1/ayah/2:284/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih, HTTP 200.
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (edition en.sahih), api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above, quoted verbatim.
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian, 马坚 (edition zh.jian), api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above, rendered verbatim with no corrections needed.
sourcing.malay: Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih (edition ms.basmeih), api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above, rendered verbatim.
sourcing.korean: Edition ko.korean, api.alquran.cloud. Translator is listed as 'Unknown' in the source's own metadata, so the on-slide credit says 'translator not specified by source'. Same live call as above; the raw string came back complete and needed no spacing correction for this particular ayah, unlike several prior posts using this edition.
sourcing.japanese: Edition ja.japanese, api.alquran.cloud. Translator is listed as 'Unknown' in the source's own metadata, cited on-slide as 'translator not specified by source'. Same live call as above, rendered verbatim with no corrections needed.
sourcing.verification_note: All six language renderings came from a single live api.alquran.cloud request made this session (2026-09-18): GET https://api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/2:284/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih, HTTP 200. See channels.json's ig-blankdiscussions._niche_note for why this project treats scripture sourcing as a hard requirement.
sourcing.compliance_check: Manually checked against scripts/data/compliance-policy.json's halal keyword-blocklists (intoxicants, pork, gambling, riba, immodesty, profanity, superstition, origins_patterns, animate_imagery, context_review). No blocklisted terms present in any of the six language texts; no imagery generated at all (pure typography slides). Content is a statement on Allah's knowledge and accountability - no context_review flags apply. Clean.
